question: What is the maximum time gap between two sessions of the State Legislature?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Six months**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The maximum time gap between two sessions of the State Legislature is **six months**.
 
• This means that the State Legislature must meet at least twice a year.
